PERFORMANCE PSA: Panic not friends, for I dug through some forum posts and found what's causing the low performance. It's simply that the dishonored 2 .exe sets itself to low process priority class whenever it loads. Setting it back to normal/above normal after each loading screen will provide a workaround until they can get around to the (very easy) patch! Additionally - the massive input delay can be fixed by setting pre-rendered frames to 1.

I’m not going to lie: if you’re genuinely trying to go outside, enjoy your day, and maintain even the slightest semblance of a positive mindset, do not touch Marvel Rivals. The game itself can be genuinely enjoyable, but the community that inhabits it is the absolute epitome of insufferable, chronically online behavior. I cannot begin to articulate the sheer frustration elicited by the abysmal gameplay of some of my teammates, whose decision-making appears to defy every conceivable principle of competence. And as for the toxicity? Don’t even get me started. The entire experience can rapidly devolve into an utterly catastrophic sh*tshow. Ironically, beneath all of this madness lies a genuinely solid game, which makes the sheer degeneracy surrounding it all the more infuriating.

This game is a perfect example of what a great story should be. Its narrative blends seamlessly with the shooter gameplay—half the time it feels like Doom, and the other half like a detective noir experience. That contrast is exactly what makes it so compelling. I don’t agree with the rating IGN gave it at all; in my opinion, this game is nearly perfect. It might not appeal to everyone, but for me, it’s been incredibly fun so far.

This game will awaken a new rage within you that are only spoken of in myths of old. After a night of golfing with my so called "Friends" the following i vowed never to speak to them. My wife mentioning that we should have them over for dinner. Hearing this sent me into a blind rage. Unable to recognize anyone or anything I set off on a path destruction across the neighborhood. I yelled at my wife which caused the dog to start barking causing me to strike the dog. Dan, my neighbor came over to investigate and was met with a swift slap to the face. The police where called and after an 18 hour stand-off and eventual trial and conviction I am serving out my time in state prison. Golf with Friends changed my life for better or worse. 10/10 would highly recommend to anyone looking for a nice relaxing night of fun with family or friends!

I see a lot of mixed reviews for this game, and honestly, each side makes valid points. 

Here are my thoughts:

Storyline-wise, I actually quite enjoyed it, though that might just be me. It did feel a bit rushed in certain areas, and some of the stealth sections got a tad tedious. My major gripe, though was that my save file got corrupted after about an hour of playing! It was incredibly frustrating having to rewatch cutscenes with no option to skip them.

However, the main highlight for me was actually playing the game with my partner. I did the controlling while we both made the choices together. Love or hate the game itself, I thoroughly enjoyed sharing the experience with them and sometimes, that’s way more important than playing a flawless 10/10 game.

Managed to clear the main game in about 8 hours over two sessions, but I missed some secrets and achievements so I'll likely put a few more hours in.  The cutesy aesthetic is nice but the combat and traversal really shines.  For a solo dev this is quite an accomplishment.
All the returning bosses got me concerned but thankfully there is no Soldier of Godrick this time, I can at least get past the tutorial now

Ori and the Will of the Wisps  is an outstanding sequel that has flawless movement mechanics that have only improved upon those of the original. New abilities make tracking through the environment seamless as you swing, dive, burrow and leap through the air. The different environments are breathtaking with vibrant landscapes and incredible art design that surpasses the first one. You can expect thrilling cinematic boss fights, new fighting abilities, emotional storyline and an excellent soundtrack. This game is a masterpiece and everyone should give this a try especially those who enjoys platformers. [100/10]
